Amount.description: Quantity of a chemical used in an Add step.
Amount.title: Amount

oneOf.description: Add a reagent, solvent, or solution to the vessel. _amount is optional — omit it when no quantity is stated in the source text; never estimate or invent a quantity.

_dropwise.description: True if the reagent is added dropwise (German: tropfenweise). Relevant for exothermic or air/moisture-sensitive additions.

_reagent.description: Name of the chemical being added, matching the name in starting_materials.

_repeat.description: Number of times this equal addition is repeated, e.g. 2 for 'NaBH4 (x2)'.

_repeat_interval.description: Waiting time between repeated additions, e.g. '2 min' for 'nach 2 min erneut versetzen'.

oneOf.title: Add

oneOf.description: Bring the mixture to a target temperature and optionally hold for a given time. _time must only be set if a duration is explicitly stated in the source text — never estimate.
oneOf.title: HeatChill

oneOf.description: Evacuate the vessel and refill with an inert gas (Schutzgas). Also used for degassing by sparging. Use as the first Prep step to establish an inert atmosphere.

_gas.description: The gas used for refilling or sparging, e.g. 'N2', 'Ar'.

_time.description: Duration of the degassing or purging cycle, e.g. 10 min for 'Entgasen (10 min)'.

oneOf.title: EvacuateAndRefill

oneOf.description: Wash a liquid phase (typically the organic phase) with an aqueous or organic solution to remove impurities. Replaces the former WashSolid type.

_phase.description: Which liquid phase is being washed. Usually 'organic'.

_repeat.description: Number of wash cycles, e.g. 2 for '2×' or '(2x)'.

_solution.description: The wash solution, e.g. 'Wasser', 'brine', 'NaCl aq. sat.', 'HCl 1M', 'NaHCO3 sat. aq.', 'NH4Cl sat. aq.'.

oneOf.title: WashPhase

oneOf.description: Wait or stir for a given duration without changing temperature.
oneOf.title: Wait

oneOf.description: Apply ultrasonic agitation for a given duration.
oneOf.title: Sonicate

oneOf.description: Dry a solution or solid using a chemical desiccant (e.g. MgSO4). After adding the desiccant, the mixture is stirred briefly and the solid filtered off. Distinct from Evaporate (which removes bulk solvent).

_desiccant.description: Desiccant used to absorb residual water, e.g. 'MgSO4', 'Na2SO4', 'CaCl2'.

oneOf.title: Dry

oneOf.description: Liquid-liquid extraction: add an immiscible solvent, mix, separate phases, and collect the target phase. Use for 'mit DEE versetzen + Phasen trennen' or 'mit DCM/MeOH extrahieren'.

_phase_kept.description: Which phase is collected after phase separation. Defaults to 'organic' in most workups.

_solvent.description: Extraction solvent or solvent mixture, e.g. 'DEE', 'DCM', 'DCM/MeOH 9:1', 'EtOAc'.

oneOf.title: Extract

oneOf.description: Remove bulk solvent under reduced pressure or with a gas stream. Use for 'LM am Roti entfernen', 'LM entfernen', 'einengen'. Distinct from Dry (which uses a desiccant).

_method.description: Method used to remove the solvent. Use 'rotary_evaporator' for 'am Roti entfernen'.

oneOf.title: Evaporate

oneOf.description: Purify the crude product by column chromatography (Säulenchromatographie). The eluent system should also be recorded in the product's eluent_system field.

_eluent.description: Eluent system, including gradients if used, e.g. 'Pe/EtOAc 3:1 → 2:1', 'PE/EE 4:1', 'DCM/MeOH 9:1'.

_stationary_phase.description: Stationary phase material. Default is silica gel (SiO2). Specify only if different.

oneOf.title: Purify

_product_portion.description: The portion containing the desired product and used for the subsequent steps

_comment.description: Free-text annotation: use for information the step type alone cannot express (repetition counts, special handling, estimated values, etc.).

_vessel.description: Reaction vessel this step occurs in, if relevant.

description: A single experiment entry from an organic chemistry lab journal (Laborjournal). Each entry documents one reaction, including all starting materials (Edukte), products (Produkte), the procedure (Vorschrift), and metadata.

batch_volume_mL.description: Total reaction volume in mL (German: 'Ansatz'). This is the reference volume used to calculate batch concentrations.
batch_volume_mL.title: Batch Volume (mL)

date.description: Date the reaction was set up (German: 'Angesetzt am'). ISO 8601 format.
date.title: Date

journal_number.description: Unique experiment identifier. For Chemotion ELN exports this is the reaction short label (Chemotion field 'short_label'), e.g. ZAR-439 or AD-R13.
journal_number.title: Journal Number

observations.description: Experimental observations and notes recorded during the reaction (German: 'Beobachtungen'). May include color changes, precipitate formation, atmosphere notes (e.g. 'Pseudo-Schutzgas' = pseudo-inert atmosphere), or deviations from procedure.
observations.title: Observations

procedure.description: Step-by-step reaction and workup procedure (German: 'Vorschrift'). Structured as three sections: Prep (preparation before the reaction), Reaction (core reaction steps), and Workup (post-reaction isolation and purification).
procedure.title: Procedure

products.description: Isolated products from the reaction (German: 'Produkte'). Usually one main product; occasionally a second product of interest.

items.description: An isolated product from the reaction with yield and characterization data.

amount_mmol.description: Isolated amount in millimoles, calculated from yield_g and molar_mass_g_mol.
amount_mmol.title: Amount (mmol)

appearance.description: Physical appearance and state (German: 'Habitus'), e.g. 'farbloser Feststoff' (colorless solid), 'gelbes Öl' (yellow oil).
appearance.title: Appearance

eluent_system.description: Solvent system used for TLC or column chromatography (German: 'Laufmittel'). Common abbreviations: Pe = petroleum ether, EtOAc/EE = ethyl acetate, DCM = dichloromethane. Ratios indicate v/v proportions.
eluent_system.title: Eluent System

is_main_product.description: True if this is the primary target product of the reaction. False for side products or byproducts isolated as secondary compounds of interest.
is_main_product.title: Is Main Product

molar_mass_g_mol.description: Molar mass of the product in g/mol.
molar_mass_g_mol.title: Molar Mass (g/mol)

name.description: Chemical name or descriptor of the product. May be a systematic name, compound class (e.g. 'tert. Amin'), or purity label (e.g. 'sauber' = pure). Compound numbers refer to journal entries.
name.title: Name

nmr_data.description: Nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy data or reference number. May be a reference to a separate NMR log entry.
nmr_data.title: NMR Data

rf_value.description: Retention factor from thin-layer chromatography (TLC), dimensionless value between 0 and 1.
rf_value.title: Rf Value

yield_g.description: Isolated yield in grams (column header 'Ausw.' = Auswaage, German for weighed amount).
yield_g.title: Yield (g)

yield_percent.description: Isolated yield as a percentage relative to the limiting reagent (column header 'Ausb.' = Ausbeute). Values above 100% indicate impure product.
yield_percent.title: Yield (%)

note.description: Supplementary note. For Chemotion this holds the product entry's short_label (the in-house ELN id).
note.title: Note

items.title: Product

products.title: Products

project_type.description: Type of academic project. Typically 'Promotion' (PhD thesis) or 'Masterarbeit' (Master's thesis).
project_type.title: Project Type

reaction_name.description: Descriptive name of the reaction, taken from the filename (without the journal number prefix). Describes the reaction type and substrates.
reaction_name.title: Reaction Name

reagent_sources.description: Storage locations or origins of each starting material (German: 'Herkunft der Edukte'). Maps reagent names to their physical location in the laboratory, e.g. 'Abzug' (fume hood), 'Bench', 'Destille' (distillation unit), or a shelf code like '167 Regal Julius'.

items.description: Storage location or provenance of a starting material.

reagent_name.description: Name of the reagent, should match a name in starting_materials.
reagent_name.title: Reagent Name

source.description: Physical storage location or origin. Common values: 'Abzug' (fume hood, synthesized in-house), 'Bench' (lab bench stock), 'Destille' (distillation unit, freshly distilled solvent), 'KS 361-A' (cabinet/shelf code). Null if not recorded.
source.title: Source / Location

items.title: Reagent Source

reagent_sources.title: Reagent Sources

research_group.description: Research group (German: 'Arbeitskreis', abbreviated AK), e.g. 'AK Laschat'.
research_group.title: Research Group

researcher.description: Full name of the researcher conducting the experiment.
researcher.title: Researcher

starting_materials.description: All educts, reagents, catalysts, bases, and solvents used in the reaction (German: 'Edukte'). Ordered as they appear in the Excel table.

items.description: A single educt, reagent, catalyst, base, or solvent entry in the Edukte table.

amount_mmol.description: Molar amount in millimoles (column header 'n'). Calculated from mass/volume and molar mass. Null for pure solvents.
amount_mmol.title: Amount (mmol)

batch_concentration_mol_L.description: Concentration of this reagent in the total reaction volume (Ansatz), in mol/L. Calculated as amount_mmol / batch_volume_mL * 1000. Null for solvents.
batch_concentration_mol_L.title: Batch Concentration (mol/L)

concentration_mol_L.description: Concentration in mol/L (column header 'c') if the reagent is used as a stock solution (e.g. 1M HCl). Null if the pure substance or a different measure is used.
concentration_mol_L.title: Stock Solution Concentration (mol/L)

density_g_mL.description: Density in g/mL (column header 'Dichte'). Used for liquid reagents when volume is measured instead of mass. Null if not applicable.
density_g_mL.title: Density (g/mL)

equivalents.description: Molar equivalents relative to the limiting reagent (column header 'eq'). The limiting reagent has eq=1. Null for solvents.
equivalents.title: Equivalents

mass_fraction_percent.description: Purity or mass fraction as a percentage (column header 'w'). Used when the reagent is not 100% pure, e.g. a technical-grade material. Null if not provided.
mass_fraction_percent.title: Mass Fraction / Purity (%)

mass_g.description: Mass used in grams. The actually measured quantity for solid reagents. Null for solvents and liquid reagents measured by volume.
mass_g.title: Mass Used (g)

molar_mass_g_mol.description: Molar mass in g/mol (column header 'M'). Null for solvents where stoichiometry is not tracked.
molar_mass_g_mol.title: Molar Mass (g/mol)

name.description: Chemical name or in-house identifier. Compound numbers (e.g. '063') refer to previous journal entries. Parenthetical suffixes encode special meaning: '(x2)' means the step/addition is performed twice; a reagent list in parentheses like '(Selectfluor/Olefin)' identifies which solutes are dissolved in this solvent.
name.title: Name

note.description: Supplementary note extracted from parenthetical suffixes or context. Examples: 'added twice (x2)', 'solvent for Selectfluor and Olefin'.
note.title: Note

role.description: Role of this compound in the reaction, inferred from chemical context and equivalents.
role.title: Chemical Role

volume_mL.description: Volume used in mL. For solvents this is the total volume added. For liquid reagents measured volumetrically. Null for solid reagents weighed by mass.
volume_mL.title: Volume Used (mL)

items.title: Starting Material

starting_materials.title: Starting Materials

tlc_conditions.description: Thin-layer chromatography monitoring conditions (German: 'DC' = Dünnschichtchromatographie). May specify eluent, staining reagent, or Rf values observed during the reaction.
tlc_conditions.title: TLC Conditions

title: Chemistry Lab Journal Entry
